guides.titleEn: The Sales Miracle & Meta-Achievements of NS2 Launch
guides.titleZh: NS2 首發神話：跨界聯手與打破歷史的評價紀錄
guides.subtitleEn: An analytical report on the groundbreaking collaboration that birthed Pokémon Pokopia, detailing its record sales and critical acclaim.
guides.subtitleZh: 《寶可夢 Pokopia》作為任天堂 Switch 2 (NS2) 平臺首發陣容的重磅衍生作，不僅達成了商業空前成功，更在評價上締造傳奇。

sections.titleEn: The Dream Team: Game Freak x Omega Force
sections.titleZh: 夢幻聯手：Game Freak 與 Omega Force
sections.contentEn: Conceived directly by Shigeru Ohmori, the game merged traditional Pokémon charm with the acclaimed sandbox expertise of Koei Tecmo's Omega Force (creators of Dragon Quest Builders).
sections.contentZh: 本作由《寶可夢 朱／紫》總監大森滋（Shigeru Ohmori）親自構思，並由 Game Freak 與具備豐富自由建造遊戲經驗的 Koei Tecmo 旗下 Omega Force 團隊（曾操刀《勇者鬥惡龍 創世小玩家》）共同開發，碰撞出前所未有的火花。

sections.titleZh: NS2 平臺首發銷售奇蹟
sections.contentEn: Released on March 5, 2026, it sold over 2.2 million copies in just four days, cementing itself as one of the fastest-selling titles in the console's history.
sections.contentZh: 於 2026 年 3 月 5 日隨 NS2 全球發行後，短短四天銷量便突破 220 萬套（日本單一市場即佔 100 萬套），並於當月全球突破 400 萬套，成為 Switch 2 平臺的現象級大作。

sections.titleZh: 突破寶可夢歷史的超高評價
sections.contentEn: With universal critical acclaim, it reached a Metacritic score of 90 — the highest of any Pokémon title ever, surpassing the prior series records held by HeartGold/SoulSilver and Black/White (both 87). Standout scores include Dexerto 10/10, VGC 5/5, and 9/10 from IGN, GameSpot, and Game Informer, backed by a 98% OpenCritic recommendation rate.
sections.contentZh: 在評價方面，本作於 Metacritic 取得 90 分「普遍好評（Must-Play）」，超越了《心金／魂銀》與《黑／白》（皆 87 分）的系列舊紀錄，成為寶可夢系列史上最高分。代表性評分包含 Dexerto 10/10、VGC 5/5，以及 IGN、GameSpot、Game Informer 的 9/10，另有高達 98% 的 OpenCritic 影評人推薦。

sections.titleZh: 底層引擎開發技術 (Katana Engine)
sections.contentEn: Pokopia is powered by the 'Katana Engine', implementing an advanced technical foundation for seamless sandbox building and deeply reactive ecological physics.
sections.contentZh: 本作採用「Katana Engine」做為底層引擎開發技術。該引擎不僅確保了大魄力土木工程的流暢穩定，更實現了極具深度的沙盒與生態物理機制。

guides.titleZh: 全生態區域拓荒與土木工程詳盡攻略
guides.subtitleEn: From the Withered Wasteland to the heights of the Sparkling Floating Island, every region in Pokopia presents unique environmental hazards and requires specific engineering tasks to restore.
guides.subtitleZh: 從面臨極端乾旱的乾巴巴荒野，到由漂浮垃圾組成的閃閃浮島，Pokopia 的每個區域都充滿官方設定的環境危機與重建任務。以下為各區域拓荒的完整解析與節點引導。

sections.titleZh: 乾巴巴荒野 (Withered Wasteland)
sections.contentEn: The starting region is plagued by extreme drought and zero vegetation. You must learn core water-shaping skills and initiate the very first computer repair.
sections.contentZh: 本作的教學與起始區域，面臨著極端的乾旱危機。百變怪玩家在此必須學習水系技能，拯救枯竭生命並啟動首座寶可夢中心。

image.captionEn: Squirtle's early water dousing is necessary to wake Onix.
image.captionZh: 傑尼龜的水槍技能是起死回生、重啟荒野的唯一捷徑。

steps.descEn: Find the dehydrated Squirtle. Guide it to hydration to copy its 'Water Gun' skill.
steps.descZh: 在乾涸的沙漠中找到脫水、奄奄一息的傑尼龜，給予水分救援後，百變怪即可學會並運用「水槍」複製專長。

steps.descEn: Squirtle Quest Application: Build a Rain Dance spot, reach 100 humidity, and trigger Slowpoke's Yawn to start the rain, freeing Onix.
steps.descZh: 傑尼龜支線重要應用：先建造「求雨地點」將區域濕度升至 100，再利用呆呆獸的完美哈欠觸發大雨軟化岩石，成功解救大岩蛇。

steps.descEn: Construct the initial infrastructure to establish a stable local headquarters and access basic workbenches.
steps.descZh: 蒐集基礎木塊與碎石，修復荒原寶可夢中心與大門，這將開啟你在 Pokopia 的正式基地與初期傢俱合成站。

sections.titleZh: 暗沉沉海邊 (Gloomy Seaside)
sections.contentEn: A flooded coastal region thick with washed-up trash and waterlogged communication terminals.
sections.contentZh: 充滿嚴重水患、陰暗霧霾且滿佈不可燃垃圾的廢棄海灘，也是玩家接觸回收與發電工業的起點。

image.captionEn: Trubbish & Garbodor process beach debris to generate early Iron Ore.
image.captionZh: 破破袋與灰塵山能將海灘鋪天蓋地的垃圾轉化為極度缺乏的鐵礦砂。

steps.descEn: Use dirt or stone block flooring to manually seal the broken fountains leaking into the computer system grid.
steps.descZh: 海灘中央的溢流噴泉正淹沒網路終端。玩家需要手動放置泥土或石地板方塊修補破損噴泉，阻斷溢流水源。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 喵喵避難所與波加曼除泥
steps.descEn: Build a shelter with a 'Mushroom Lamp' for Meowth to lure Piplup to wash away heavy mud banks.
steps.descZh: 為喵喵建造包含「蘑菇燈」的專屬避難所，這能吸引波加曼使用水流清洗沉重的泥堆，隨後建立垃圾收集站吸引破破袋。

steps.descEn: Wake Mosslax. Locate and repair the coastal water wheel, windmill, and local charging station. Pave Power Poles to complete the network.
steps.descZh: 喚醒發電巨樹（Mosslax），修復海灘風力發電機、燈塔水車與底座充電站，製作架設「電線桿」將導線引入城鎮，讓火系夥伴維持最大發電點亮城鎮。

steps.descEn: Prioritize recruiting Wooper here. Its special ability continuously scatters clay nearby, essential for later construction.
steps.descZh: 在這裡優先招募會亂撒素材的「烏波」，牠定居後會在住處周圍自動產出黏土，為後期的重工業建材做準備。

sections.titleZh: 凸隆隆山地 (Bulging Highlands)
sections.contentEn: Buried beneath layers of dense volcanic ash, this region hides lost temples, culinary masters, and deep metallurgical ores.
sections.contentZh: 被厚重火山灰完全掩埋的巨型遺跡與紅色巖壁地盆，這裡是玩家冶煉銅鐵錠與碎裂堅硬金屬塊的修煉場。

image.captionEn: Magmar powers up furnaces inside the furnace chamber.
image.captionZh: 鴨嘴火獸能提供超高窯烤燃燒專長，幫助熔煉與鍛造高強度金屬。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 烤製麵包解救主廚 Dente
steps.descEn: Locate trapped Dente. Build a 'Bread Oven' to bake wheat bread, eat it to gain strength, and hack his chain bonds.
steps.descZh: 在巖壁深處的土屑平房內尋獲受困的廚師「Dente」。玩家需就地搭建「麵包爐」，烤製小麥麵包並一口吃下，獲得怪力擊碎鐵鍊救出主廚。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 漢堡排廚藝與強化碎巖術
steps.descEn: Bring Magmar to furnace, smelt copper to forge a Frying Pan. Cook and eat a Burger Patty to upgrade Ditto's Rock Smash.
steps.descZh: 吸引鴨嘴火獸（Magmar），運用其熔爐燃燒天賦將銅礦石冶製成銅錠，打造「平底鍋」。烹煮並享用多汁的「漢堡排」以永久強化百變怪的「碎巖」專長，足以擊碎黑色巨型金屬塊！

steps.descEn: Recruit Timburr for faster building, learn cooking for Transformation buffs, and use Graveler form for traversal.
steps.descZh: 修復礦洞之餘，優先招募搬運小匠解鎖「建造加速」；學會料理配方能大幅強化百變怪的變身能力；並多加利用隆隆石型態進行快速移動。

sections.titleZh: Sparkling Floating Island 特殊區域通關攻略
sections.contentEn: Floating trash islands and massive unfinished skyscrapers. Requires advanced aerial traversal and skyscraper architectural blueprints. Refer to the Eurogamer exclusive walkthrough.
sections.contentZh: 由漫天漂浮的科技廢棄垃圾島嶼、巨鋼鷹架與未完工摩天大樓組成的超高海拔區域，土木工程消耗最巨。參閱 Eurogamer 的專題通關攻略。

image.captionEn: Establish Waterside Boat to copy Dragonite's Glide skill.
image.captionZh: 快龍的加入能使玩家傲視群雄，滑翔穿梭於相隔甚遠的雲霧空島。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 水邊小艇與快龍滑翔天空
steps.descEn: Build a Waterside Boat habitat to summon Dragonite and copy its Glide ability, opening flight pathways.
steps.descZh: 在浮島邊緣設立優雅的「水邊小艇」棲息地以吸引高傲的快龍（Dragonite），向其模仿「滑翔」實用天賦，方能平穩橫渡致命高空裂隙。

steps.descEn: Meet Tinkmaster. Trade Concrete and Iron Ingots to acquire Special Gears to assembly the elevator platform.
steps.descZh: 找到空島頂端的主匠巨鍛匠（Tinkmaster），繳交重型混凝土與鐵錠，訂製關鍵的「特殊齒輪」，並藉此修復跨區域的重力升降平臺。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 摩天大樓重建（2F → 4F 全樓層）
steps.descEn:
Reconstruct the skyscraper floor by floor — each floor takes a full hour of real time to cure before the next can begin.
• 2F: 25 Concrete · 10 Glass · 5 Pokémetal · 10 Iron Ingots.
• 3F: 25 Concrete · 10 Glass · 10 Glow Stones · 15 Copper Ingots. Return to Bulging Highlands to shove a Strength block and mine the Glow Stones, then escort Chef Dente up to assist.
• 4F: 40 Concrete · 15 Glass · 10 Paper · 10 Bricks · 20 Lumber. You are forced to personally return to Gloomy Seaside to invite the named Pokémon Peakychu into the 6-mon workforce, and the floor takes a mandatory 1 real-time hour to build. Completing 4F and stepping onto the rooftop triggers the Mewtwo encounter.
steps.descZh:
逐層重建這座終極摩天大樓，每一層皆需現即時間整整 1 小時凝固成形，才能接續下一層。
• 2F：25 混凝土 · 10 玻璃 · 5 寶可金屬 · 10 鐵錠。
• 3F：25 混凝土 · 10 玻璃 · 10 發光石 · 15 銅錠。需回到凸隆隆山地推開力量方塊開採發光石，並護送主廚 Dente 前來協助。
• 4F 建設需求：40 混凝土、15 玻璃、10 紙張、10 磚塊、20 木材。施工班底強制為「暗沉沉海邊特定皮卡丘 (Peakychu)」加上 5 隻任意寶可夢一同施工。實時建造等待時間需「現即時間整整 1 小時」。完工後步上屋頂觸發與超夢 (Mewtwo) 的相遇。

sections.titleZh: 調色板鎮 / 空空鎮主線收尾
sections.contentEn: The crucial transition from regional puzzles to the true endgame sandbox.
sections.contentZh: 進入終局自由建造區前的最後主線考驗與人口數量管理。

steps.descEn: Collect the 5 Mystic Slates to fully restore the City Center. This welcomes human NPCs back to town, formally unlocking multiplayer.
steps.descZh: 收集 5 塊神秘石板來徹底重建市中心。迎接人類 NPC 回歸城鎮後，正式解鎖聯機多人遊玩功能。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 人口上限與甜甜蜜調度
steps.descEn: The map global cap is ~20 to 22 Pokémon. Use Sweet Honey to forcefully summon specific workers directly to your construction sites.
steps.descZh: 管理全區 20-22 隻的寶可夢數量上限。如果因為人口滿載導致找不到特定打工仔，善用「甜甜蜜」從棲息地將牠們強制召喚過來。

guides.titleZh: 新手必讀：實用 QoL 密技與隱藏自動化機制
guides.subtitleEn: From linking your storage boxes to forming the ultimate automated production trio, these are the early-game secrets and mechanics the game doesn't explicitly tell you.
guides.subtitleZh: 從收納箱與工作臺的連動，到如何湊齊後期最強的自動化生產三人組，這裡整理了遊戲初期必須瞭解的隱藏機制與小細節。

sections.titleZh: 新手首選推薦：妙蛙種子
sections.contentEn: When choosing your first partner, Bulbasaur is highly recommended. Not only does it have the 'Farming' specialty that significantly accelerates early crop yields, but placing tall-grass habitats early on quickly levels up your Environment Level, unlocking crucial workbench upgrades.
sections.contentZh: 在選擇初始夥伴時，極度推薦擁有「栽種」專長的妙蛙種子。牠不僅能大幅加速初期的農場收成，配合盡早佈置長草棲息地，能讓你快速提升「環境等級」，提前解鎖關鍵的工作臺升級圖紙。

image.captionEn: Bulbasaur is highly recommended for starting farmers due to its Leafage skill.
image.captionZh: 妙蛙種子因具備「栽種」與「樹葉」專長，也是新手農夫非常推薦的開局選擇。

steps.descEn: Utilize Leafage and Farming talents of Bulbasaur to secure early wheat and tomato output.
steps.descZh: 利用妙蛙種子的「栽種」與「樹葉」專長，在初創農田瞬間加速各類穀物收割，不需浪費手動體力。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 大批鋪設高草叢與樹木
steps.descEn: Bulbasaur and bird variants love greenery. Paving hedges expands town score quickly in the first 24 hours.
steps.descZh: 在基地周遭緊湊地鋪設 10-15 格高草與樹籬，能在第一天就取得充沛的城鎮綠意加成，極限拉高環境評分。

sections.titleZh: 超級自動化生產三人組
sections.contentEn: Once you hit the mid-game, manual material gathering becomes a chore. To fully automate, recruit Garbodor (Recycle), Aipom (Gather), and Pikachu (Generate). Aipom collects scattered raw materials, Garbodor converts trash into usable ores, and Pikachu powers the processing machinery. Placing their habitats tightly around a central refinement block yields a self-sustaining loop.
sections.contentZh: 當你開始面臨資源短缺時，務必設法湊齊「灰塵山＋長尾怪手＋皮卡丘」的超級自動化生產三人組。長尾怪手負責搬運，皮卡丘負責發電照明，而灰塵山與破破袋能將垃圾不斷轉化為鐵礦，解決中期鐵錠短缺的大麻煩。

image.captionEn: Trubbish & Garbodor form the backbone of your automated trash-to-iron factory line.
image.captionZh: 灰塵山、長尾怪手與皮卡丘是前中期的自動化鐵礦生產三人組，能大幅提升生產效率。

steps.descEn: Aipom serves as the logistical spine, sweeping raw materials from gathering nodes to storages automatically.
steps.descZh: 指派長尾怪手負責所有資源堆的就近搬運與庫存歸檔，完全消滅玩家每次跑來跑去搬原木的體力垃圾時間。

steps.descEn: Place Recycle specialty near coastal scrap yards to convert unburnable rubbish into highly-coveted raw iron ore.
steps.descZh: 將灰塵山與破破袋緊密配置在回收大氣泡周圍，源源不絕將不可燃的海灘廢品過濾提煉為純淨鐵砂。

steps.descEn: Pikachu provides electricity to accelerate furnace blowers and workspace comfort light.
steps.descZh: 電氣屬性皮卡丘負責為所有的研磨器、大熔煉鼓風爐及自動包裝裝置高頻發電，使整條產線滿載運算。

sections.titleZh: 工作臺連動與鋪路快捷鍵
sections.contentEn: These hidden QoL mechanics—widely shared on community boards like Bahamut—save enormous amounts of manual effort once your town starts to scale up.
sections.contentZh: 以下是巴哈姆特等社群廣為流傳的隱藏 QoL 機制。當你的城鎮開始巨型化時，善用它們能省下大量手動操作的時間。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 收納箱與工作臺自動連動
steps.descEn: Place a Storage Box within 8 blocks of any Workbench and the bench will pull materials straight from the box during crafting — no need to shuffle items into your pockets first.
steps.descZh: 只要將「收納箱」放置在距離「工作臺」8 格的範圍以內，工作臺合成時就會自動讀取箱內物資，完全不需先手動把材料挪進背包。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 按住 B 鍵連續舖設與對齊
steps.descEn: For large landscaping jobs—such as Umbreon's 300 road blocks or Jolteon's 100 electrical blocks—long-press the 'B' key while moving to auto-lay flooring continuously in a straight line with clean terrain alignment.
steps.descZh: 面對大型整地與快速對齊工程（例如月亮伊布的 300 條實體道路或雷伊布的 100 塊電力方塊），只要按住「B」鍵不放邊走，就能一鍵連續舖設並自動對齊地形。

steps.descEn: Scroll the D-pad to instantly switch between copied abilities, and quickly assign a specific Pokémon to a task—such as commissioning a Fire-type to keep an ore furnace burning.
steps.descZh: 利用十字鍵快速捲動切換已複製的能力，並迅速指派特定寶可夢執行工作，例如委託火系夥伴持續顧著熔礦爐燒礦。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 巴哈密傳：金幣與交易機制
steps.descEn:
Coin Farming Secret: After early-game progression, use 'Rock Smash' (碎巖) in Bulging Highlands to mine high-purity metal ores, and assign Fire-type Pokémon to refine them efficiently into 'Gold Ingots' and 'Copper Ingots'.

Trading Partners: Bring these refined ingots along with extra paper or bricks to Empty Town. Trade them with Eevee (which has the 'Trading' specialty) to exchange for a wealth of coins, which can then be used to purchase hidden furniture blueprints inside Pokeballs.
steps.descZh:
賺錢金祕技：開局解鎖「碎巖」後，在凸隆隆山地（Bulging Highlands）開採高純度金屬礦，並指派火系寶可夢在熔爐高效率精鍊為「金錠」與「銅錠」。

交易對象：將精煉獲得的建材與多餘的紙張、磚塊，攜至空空鎮（Empty Town）向具備「交易」專長的伊布（Eevee）兌換大量金幣，以購買精靈球中的隱秘傢俱藍圖。

sections.titleZh: 營運最佳化：監視器與電磁飄浮
sections.contentEn: As your town grows huge, two endgame tools eliminate the most tedious chores: remote monitoring and telekinetic terraforming.
sections.contentZh: 隨著城鎮巨型化，兩項後期工具能徹底消除最繁瑣的雜事：遠端監控與隔空整地。

steps.descEn: Install cameras to monitor habitats remotely and receive a notification the moment a target Pokémon spawns—removing the need to patrol back and forth across regions.
steps.descZh: 架設監視器即可遠端監控各棲息地，當目標寶可夢生成時立即收到通知，徹底解決反覆跨區巡邏的困擾。

steps.descEn: Post-game, find Magnemite in the spaceship crater and build a 'Factory Warehouse' habitat (Metal Drum, Messy Cables, Control Unit, Street Lamp) to learn it. Press Y to instantly recycle blocks; hold Y to telekinetically grab and relocate entire trees or boulders—completely revolutionizing large-scale terraforming.
steps.descZh: 通關後在太空船坑洞中發現小磁怪，建立「工廠倉庫」棲息地（需金屬桶、凌亂電線、控制單元與路燈）後即可習得。按 Y 鍵可瞬間破壞回收方塊；長按 Y 鍵則能隔空抓取並移動整棵樹木或巨石，徹底顛覆大規模地形改造的體驗。

sections.titleZh: 進階家裝：如何避免棲息地需求衝突
sections.contentEn: A crucial mechanic highlighted in Eurogamer's walkthrough. When placing decorations, nearby habitats can mistakenly borrow or conflict with the attributes of adjacent items.
sections.contentZh: 根據 Eurogamer 通關攻略提出的警告：當你在同一區域密集建置多個棲息地時，極易發生「傢俱屬性干擾」的衝突。學會利用特定物件作為結界，是後期高效招募的必備技巧。

steps.descEn: Items placed within a 3x3 block radius of another habitat can throw off its environment tags (e.g., adding a Torch near an Ice habitat raises warmth, evicting ice Pokémon).
steps.descZh: 如果你在冰系寶可夢的棲地旁（3x3 網格內）放置了帶有「溫暖」或「光源」屬性的傢俱（如火把），會直接破壞原有棲地的「寒冷」標籤，導致冰系寶可夢拒絕入住。

steps.descEn: Eurogamer recommends building "Neutral Blockers" like simple brick walls or plain wood fences to legally separate environments without taking up huge gaps.
steps.descZh: Eurogamer 強烈建議：使用無干擾屬性的「紅磚牆」或「原木柵欄」作為物理阻斷結界。這類中性物件能有效切斷傢俱標籤之間的互相借用與疊加，讓你能將高腳椅酒吧與水草魚缸緊密相鄰建造。

sections.titleZh: 進階開荒：定居機制與家屋建構 (來源：PoGoskill)
sections.contentEn: To stop Pokémon from taking up temporary habitat spawns, you must build them permanent homes.
sections.contentZh: 只建置「棲息地」雖然能吸引寶可夢，但會佔用該處的生成上限。根據 PoGoskill 攻略指出，你必須為牠們建造專屬房屋，讓牠們「定居」並釋放棲息地空間。

steps.descEn: A valid permanent house requires exactly: 4 enclosed walls, at least 2 blocks high, 1 door, and 3 pieces of furniture.
steps.descZh: 符合系統判定的「家屋」需要：四周封閉的牆壁、至少 2 格的高度、1 扇門，以及內部放置滿 3 件傢俱。完成後寶可夢會正式移居，原先的棲息地就能再刷新下一隻寶可夢！

steps.nodeTitleZh: 非戰鬥拓荒與地圖移動難點
steps.descEn: Overcome environmental blockages through creative interactions: fix bleeding coastal geysers using dirt/stone blocks, eat camp-baked bread to sever lock chains in Bulging Highlands, learn Dragonite's glide to bridge high-altitude voids, and eat camper burgers to smash heavy blocks for legendary encounters.
steps.descZh: 本作取消戰鬥，推進全靠環境智慧：在暗沉沉海邊需舖設泥土/石地板方塊堵住破損噴泉以排水；在凸隆隆山地需烤製包商吐司並食入以拉斷鎖鏈解救主廚 Dente；在閃閃浮島需藉水邊小艇棲息地引來快龍學會「滑翔」飛渡深谷；在夢境群島則要在營地烹調漢堡排食入以碎巖破壞阻隔雷公的特殊金屬方塊。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 新分區高階寶可夢吸引演算法
steps.descEn: To lure evolved or high-tier Pokémon, follow the Habitat Drive Model: achieve local Environment Levels, place requisite furniture ratios as an anchor, and unlock special food recipes linked to friendship thresholds (Lv. 5 for Stage 1, Lv. 10 for Stage 2, e.g. Greenhouse items + Ancient Totems for Venusaur; 10 water habitats for Vaporeon's Ice Cream Soda).
steps.descZh: 高階進化體不存在野外隨機升等，需靠「棲息地驅動模型 (Habitat Drive)」吸引：確保地區環境評定 (Environment Level) 超標，放置錨定特定喜好 (Likes) 的物件（如明亮、潮濕、溫室），並將前置幼體友情感情刷滿解鎖終極食譜（友情5級解鎖一階，10級解鎖最終型態，如妙蛙花最愛古木圖騰，水伊布則需空空鎮10個水系棲地解鎖的「冰淇淋汽水」）。

sections.titleZh: 隱藏介面與 QoL 系統實作
sections.contentEn: Pokopia incorporates several hidden quality-of-life features into its UI to reduce anxiety and enhance the sandbox experience without cluttering the screen.
sections.contentZh: 本作將許多便利的系統功能隱藏在選單與特定設施中，讓你在享受純淨畫面的同時又能解決繁瑣問題。

steps.descEn: The '3D Printer' inside the Pokémon Center allows players to directly duplicate any object from a 'previously taken Precious Photo', saving you from manual recipe grinding.
steps.descZh: 寶可夢中心內建的「3D 列印機」，允許玩家直接複製任何「曾經拍攝過的照片中」的物件，免去重新蒐集材料的農作之苦。

steps.descEn: The game tracks a 24-hour real-time clock, but cleverly tucks it away inside the pause menu to prevent players from feeling time-anxiety during construction.
steps.descZh: 遊戲擁有 24 小時即時時鐘機制，但巧妙隱藏於選單中，以此避免玩家產生時間焦慮（不用盯著日夜交替圖示趕進度）。

steps.descEn: The pause menu features a built-in function to 'fast travel directly back to regional homes', saving massive amounts of walking when transitioning between regions.
steps.descZh: 暫停選單內建「直接傳送回各區域住家」的功能，讓你在長途跋涉或不小心摔進深谷時能瞬間歸巢。

sections.titleZh: 連線機制與外觀自訂
sections.contentEn: Pokopia includes robust social tools and personalization features to tailor the sandbox journey.
sections.contentZh: 本作不僅支援強大的社群共建功能，也提供了豐富的主角外觀自訂系統。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 多人連線與 GameShare 機制
steps.descEn: Supports up to 4 players (local/online). Features innovative 'GameShare': via GameChat, you can invite friends to play in your town even if they don't own the game or are playing on an original Switch.
steps.descZh: 本作支援最高 4 人（本地/線上）連線，且內建創新的「GameShare」功能，可透過 GameChat 邀請即使未擁有該遊戲軟體、甚至使用初代 Switch 的朋友進入城鎮遊玩。

steps.descEn: As a Ditto mimicking human form, players can fully customize their skin color, hair color, and clothing throughout the adventure.
steps.descZh: 玩家扮演的百變怪，在模仿為人類型態時可以「自訂膚色、髮色與服裝」，隨時展現獨一無二的個人風格。

guides.titleEn: All Legendary Encounters: Beasts, Birds, Mewtwo & Mew
guides.titleZh: 全傳說寶可夢遭遇攻略：聖獸、神鳥、超夢與夢幻
guides.subtitleEn: From the first clifftop sighting of Raikou to the 27-slate Mew puzzle, Pokopia hides its legendaries behind major engineering projects and world-spanning scavenger hunts. Here is every encounter, in the order you can reasonably reach them.
guides.subtitleZh: 從懸崖頂端初見雷公，到 27 塊石板的夢幻解謎，Pokopia 將傳說寶可夢深埋在宏大工藝與地道探索後。本篇為您排除所有幻覺，匯集各大前線最精確的召喚指南。

stats.optimalTimeZh: 通關後最頂級戰術挑戰

sections.titleZh: 劇情關底傳說：蓋歐卡與波爾凱尼恩
sections.contentEn: Each main-story chapter culminates in a legendary tied to its element — a layer beyond the post-game beasts and birds. Chapter 1 (Withered Wasteland): raise moisture to 75 to trigger rain, then Kyogre appears as the finale encounter and your trainer rank advances. Chapter 2 (Bulging Highlands): smelt metals, cook skill-boost dishes, raise the party atmosphere to 100, and Volcanion emerges at the volcano summit. Chapter 3 (Gloomy Seaside): learn Surf, restore the three generators to brightness 80, wake Snorlax, and Raikou appears at the cave top.
sections.contentZh: 本作每個主線章節的結尾，都會迎來一隻對應該區元素的傳說寶可夢，是後期三神鳥與三聖獸之外的另一層設計。第一章（乾巴巴荒野）：將潤澤度提升至 75 點觸發降雨後，蓋歐卡會作為關底登場，訓練家階級隨之晉升。第二章（凸隆隆山地）：冶煉金屬、烹調技能強化料理、將派對氣氛值提升至 100 後，波爾凱尼恩會在火山山頂現身。第三章（暗沉沉海邊）：習得衝浪、修復三座發電機使亮度達 80、喚醒卡比獸後，雷公會在洞穴頂端登場。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 蓋歐卡・第一章降雨關底
steps.descEn: Withered Wasteland. After raising moisture to 75 and triggering the rainfall sequence, complete Kyogre's activity chain to register it and rank up.
steps.descZh: 乾巴巴荒野。將潤澤度提升至 75 並完成降雨流程後，跟著完成蓋歐卡的一連串活動即可登錄並晉升階級。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 波爾凱尼恩・第二章火山關底
steps.descEn: Bulging Highlands. Rescue the chef Greedent, smelt copper/iron, cook skill dishes, then raise party atmosphere to 100 to summon Volcanion at the summit.
steps.descZh: 凸隆隆山地。救出主廚藏飽栗鼠、冶煉銅鐵、烹調強化料理，再將派對氣氛值拉到 100，即可在山頂召喚波爾凱尼恩。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 雷公・第三章海灘電網
steps.descEn: Gloomy Seaside. Learn Surf, restore the wind/water/fire generators to brightness 80, wake Snorlax, and meet Raikou at the cave top (consistent with the post-game Dream-Island recruit route).
steps.descZh: 暗沉沉海邊。習得衝浪、修復風／水／火三座發電機使亮度達 80、喚醒卡比獸，即可在洞穴頂端遇見雷公（與後期夢境島招募路線一致）。

sections.titleZh: 雷公 ── 雷鳴夢境群島
sections.contentEn: Raikou is the first legendary you can reach. The first sighting is free, but full recruitment routes through the randomly generated Dream Islands.
sections.contentZh: 雷公是你能接觸到的第一隻傳說寶可夢。初次目睹是免費的，但要真正收歸麾下，必須經由隨機生成的夢境群島才能達成。

steps.descEn: After lighting up Gloomy Seaside by connecting every renewable power source, climb to the clifftop to meet Raikou for the very first time.
steps.descZh: 在暗沉沉海邊完成所有再生能源串聯、點亮城鎮後，攀上懸崖頂端，即可與雷公初次碰面。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 飄飄球與夢境群島入口
steps.descEn: Hand a Pikachu Doll to Drifloon to be carried to the 'Pikachu Doll Dream Island (Oceanic)'. The doll type determines the island biome.
steps.descZh: 將「皮卡丘娃娃」交予飄飄球（Drifloon），由牠帶你飛抵「皮卡丘娃娃夢境島（海洋型）」。娃娃的種類會決定島嶼的生物群系。

steps.descEn: Venture into the cave's deepest chamber, eat a Burger Patty acquired from the camp to power up Rock Smash, and shatter the heavy metal blocks sealing the core. Recruiting Raikou dramatically boosts the region's environment level.
steps.descZh: 進入「皮卡丘娃娃夢境島 (海洋型)」後，玩家必須食用在營地取得的「漢堡排」來觸發怪力，才能擊碎阻擋雷公的特殊金屬方塊。成功招募雷公後，可大幅提升該區域的環境等級。

sections.titleZh: 夢幻 ── 27 塊阿爾法未知石板壁畫
sections.contentEn: Mew is locked behind a major geographical exploration puzzle. There are precisely 27 alphabetical slot gaps on Withered Wasteland mural. No shortcuts exist — bring a Search specialty teammate or a Dowsing Machine to spot glowing golden sites.
sections.contentZh: 在無垠的乾巴巴荒野（Withered Wasteland），隱藏著一幅雕刻著 27 個未知圖騰 (Unown) 英文字母插槽的古老地底壁畫。要與夢幻做夥伴，你必須解開這個龐大的石板解謎工程。

image.captionEn: Mew unlocks only after inserting all 27 distinct mysterious slates in Withered Wasteland.
image.captionZh: 夢幻在壁畫石板槽完美填入 27 枚不同字母塊後便會祥和而降。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 尋墓：破壁進入地下暗道
steps.descEn: The entrance is located at the north end of the brick road on the right side of the Withered Wasteland Pokémon Center. Break the cracked wall with Rock Smash, turn left, and cut through the metal fencing with an upgraded Cut to descend to the bottom of the underground passage where the mural with 27 Unown gaps is found.
steps.descZh: 位置在乾巴巴荒野精靈中心右側碎磚路北端。破壁路徑：碎巖（擊破裂壁） ➔ 左轉 ➔ 強化居合斬（切開金屬網） ➔ 自通道下行至最深處抵達地下通道底部壁畫（具有 27 個未知圖騰 Unown 字母與標點符號型態插槽）。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 挖掘：蒐集 27 顆神秘石板
steps.descEn: Raid random golden shiny dig points globally. Bring partners with 'Search' talent or craft a Dowsing Machine to map and collect all 27 non-overlapping mysterious slates.
steps.descZh: 需攜帶具備「搜尋」專長的寶可夢同行，或使用「尋寶機器（Dowsing Machine）」探測世界各地荒野中隨機出現的「發光黃金挖掘點」，收集 27 塊互不重複的「神秘石板」。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 填槽：組裝壁面引導夢幻
steps.descEn: Slide all 27 alphabetical slates correctly into the ancient mural slots to summon the playful phantom.
steps.descZh: 走回地下暗道，將收集的 27 個圖騰石板一一滑入古老遺跡壁凹槽內。拼圖完成瞬間，夢幻將在神聖光暈中出現，高興地與玩家碰拳同行！

sections.titleZh: 解鎖召喚傳奇：鳳王與洛奇亞神之鈴鐺
sections.contentEn: Exclusive summoning bells require cross-referenced milestones to trigger. Complete the requirements from community databases.
sections.contentZh: 這兩位神話守護者從不隨意降風。要解鎖引導道具「透明鈴鐺」與「海神鈴鐺」配方，你需要滿足極為宏大的城都與關都探索成就。

image.captionEn: Lugia listens to the coastal bell toll.
image.captionZh: 海神洛奇亞會在地底海角或發電廠港灣傾聽「海神鈴鐺」的深海鳴響。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 招募三聖獸，解鎖「透明鈴鐺」
steps.descEn: Recruiting the third Johto legendary beast (Raikou, Entei, or Suicune) in the Dream Islands unlocks the 'Clear Bell' crafting recipe, which is used to summon Ho-Oh from the high peaks of Empty Town.
steps.descZh: 「透明鈴鐺（Clear Bell）」配方需於夢境島（Dream Islands）成功招募齊全第三隻城都傳說聖獸（雷公/水君/炎帝）後方能解鎖，用於在調色板鎮最高峰召喚鳳王。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 完成發電廠遇閃電鳥，解鎖「海神鈴鐺」
steps.descEn: Completing the Abandoned Power Plant and encountering Zapdos (specifically as the last of the three legendary birds) unlocks the 'Tidal Bell' recipe, used to summon Lugia from the seaside cliffs.
steps.descZh: 「海神鈴鐺（Tidal Bell）」配方需在完成廢棄發電廠的終極大型土木工程且最後遭遇閃電鳥（若其為你遇到關都三神鳥的最後一隻）時才能解鎖，用以在岸邊山崖召喚洛奇亞。

sections.titleEn: Legendary Birds (Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres) Location & Capture Guide
sections.titleZh: 傳說三鳥 (Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres) 尋找與定位攻略
sections.contentEn: Constructing the sacred elements of Kanto birds is highly demanding on materials and specified labor fields. See the comprehensive guides tracking Zapdos and navigating the Sanctuaries.
sections.contentZh: 在空空鎮的三個島嶼頂點，靜躺著三個巨大金色精靈球，裡面裝載著三神鳥祭壇的終極大型土木工程圖紙。這些工程耗資之恐怖，位列全作之首。包含閃電鳥 (Zapdos) 捕捉任務指南。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 火焰鳥的烈焰祭壇 (Altar of Flame)
steps.descEn: Requires 50 Copper Ingots, 50 Gold Ingots, 50 Lava Rocks, and 10 Pokémetals. Player forums calculated the grid footprint of the Altar of Flame at an astonishing 33x35 massive grid. Players must dig deep trenches to perform "lava fluid mechanics" diversion and defense.
steps.descZh:
建材配方：50 個銅錠、50 個金錠、50 個熔岩岩石、10 個高階寶可金屬。
注意事項：玩家論壇精確算出了傳說寶可夢的棲息地網格數值。「烈焰祭壇 (炎帝 / 火焰鳥)」佔地極高，達到了驚人的 33x35 巨大網格。玩家必須開鑿深溝，進行「熔岩流體力學」的疏導防禦。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 閃電鳥 (Zapdos) 廢棄發電廠捕捉任務指南
steps.descEn: Requires 50 Copper Ingots, 50 Iron Ingots, 50 Sea Glass Shards, 50 Bricks, and 10 Pokemetals. Construction relies on exactly 15 active Pokémon working simultaneously. The workforce must precicely include: 1 with Build, 1 with Generate, 1 with Crush, and 1 with Fly specialties, none of which can be missing.
steps.descZh: 高階耗材需求：50 銅錠、50 鐵錠、50 海玻璃碎片、50 磚塊、10 寶可金屬。限定高達 15 隻寶可夢同時開工，且參與成員的專長必須精確滿足：1 隻建造 (Build)、1 隻發電 (Generate)、1 隻粉碎 (Crush)、1 隻飛行 (Fly) 專長，缺一不可。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 急凍鳥的冰結之室 (Freezing Chambers)
steps.descEn: Requires 50 Stone, 50 Ice Blocks, 10 Crystal Shards, and 10 Pokemetals. Construct on highest cold peaks.
steps.descZh:
建材配方：50 石體塊、50 凜冬冰塊、10 深邃水晶碎片、10 高階寶可金屬。
建造細節：建在北邊孤崖頂點。冰塊需使用冰系寶可夢在淡水盆批次吐息凝結產出。

guides.titleEn: Team Initiation Challenge: Complete 8 Badges Pathway
guides.titleZh: 團隊入會挑戰：全 8 枚徽章物資需求與通關路徑
guides.subtitleEn: To trigger the final credits and complete your restoration journey, you must submit specific materials at the mysterious tower on Gloomy Seaside to acquire all 8 badges.
guides.subtitleZh: 為瞭解鎖終局製作人員名單、完成世界復育之旅，玩家必須在暗沉沉海邊的神秘高塔中，依序交納對應的重工業精煉物資，取得象徵榮耀的 8 枚徽章。以下為各階段的詳盡需求與拓荒指引。

sections.titleZh: 第 1 至 4 階段：基建與精煉物資考驗
sections.contentEn: These early badges test basic farming and metallurgy refinement skills.
sections.contentZh: 前四枚徽章著重於檢驗玩家在基本農業、簡易加工與初期重金屬冶煉方面的自動化搭建水平。

steps.descEn:
Requires 5 Nanab Berries (蘋野果).
Strategy: Simply perform a Headbutt (頭錘) action on any Nanab Berry tree in Withered Wasteland.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：5 顆蘋野果 (Nanab Berries)。
獲取策略：對著乾巴巴荒野中的蘋野果樹施展「頭錘」衝撞即可輕鬆震落，是毫無壓力的第一關卡。

steps.descEn:
Requires 10 Beans, 10 Tomatoes, 10 Wheat.
Strategy: Beans and Tomatoes are mined/foraged on Gloomy Seaside. Wheat crops must be unlocked in Bulging Highlands first.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：10 顆豆子、10 顆番茄、10 綑小麥。
獲取策略：豆子與番茄可直接在暗沉沉海邊採集取得；小麥則需要先推進主線至凸隆隆山地，獲得種子後回基地栽種收割。

steps.descEn:
Requires 20 Lumber, 5 Wool, 10 Paper.
Strategy: Extract Lumber via Scyther (Cut), periodic fleece from Mareep for Wool, and refine waste paper in Sparking Skylands via Recycle specialty (Trubbish) to yield Paper.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：20 塊木材、5 捲絨毛、10 張紙張。
獲取策略：圓木需委託飛天螳螂以「居合斬」加工成木材；絨毛需建造咩利羊棲息地定期收割；紙張則在空島收集廢紙後交由破破袋提煉。

steps.descEn:
Requires 40 Bricks, 20 Gold Ingots, 50 Concrete.
Strategy: Bake Soft Clay (triggered by rain) via Torchic to get Bricks. Melt Gold ore in Bulging Highlands. Process Limestone via Golem and Conkeldurr in the Concrete Mixer.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：40 塊磚塊、20 塊金錠、50 塊混凝土。
獲取策略：軟泥（下雨天於荒原取得）委託火稚雞或小火龍窯烤成紅磚；金錠於凸隆隆山地開採熔煉；混凝土則需在空島利用隆隆巖和修建老匠在攪拌機中加工。

sections.titleZh: 第 5 至 8 階段：高階電網、傢俱裝潢與終局通關
sections.contentEn: The final stretch tests large-scale energy piping, advanced furniture manufacturing, and ultimate game completion.
sections.contentZh: 最後四枚徽章對玩家的跨區域調電能力、高階生活傢俱圖紙收集度，以及大後期成就提出了全方位檢配要求。

steps.descEn:
Requires 50 Electricity, 10 Crystal Shards, 5 Special Gears.
Strategy: Wire coastal wind/water electric hubs to the tower using Power Poles. Dig Crystal Shards in Bulging Highlands. Commission Tinkmaster (Tinkaton) in Skylands for Special Gears.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：50 點電力、10 個水晶碎片、5 個特殊齒輪。
獲取策略：玩家需架設大量電線桿，將海灘的風力與水輪發電機電網拉至高塔；水晶碎片在遺跡開採取得；齒輪則需帶混凝土和鐵錠向空島的巨鍛匠訂製。

steps.descEn:
Requires 4 Industrial Beds, 4 Resort Lamps, 4 Office Desks.
Strategy: Find furniture blueprints inside Poké Balls hidden across various biomes, craft them on the advanced workbench.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：4 張工業床、4 盞度假村燈、4 張辦公桌。
獲取策略：考驗傢俱合成能力。此階段所需的進階傢俱藍圖全數散落於世界遍地的隱秘精靈球中，收集齊全後在工作臺消耗金屬與布料進行裝潢合成實物。

steps.descEn:
Requires 1 Washing Machine, 1 Refrigerator, 1 Game Boy.
Strategy: Reach Level 5 Environment Level in the three starting areas to unlock appliances. The rare Game Boy component is gifted upon maxing out Sparkling Floating Island.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：1 臺洗衣機、1 臺冰箱、1 臺 Game Boy。
獲取策略：家電大廠解鎖！洗衣機與冰箱的設計圖需要玩家將前三個生態區的環境評分提升至滿級 5 級方能解鎖；最為稀有且昂貴的 Game Boy 則是空島滿級時的專屬餽贈圖紙。

steps.descEn:
Requires 1 Precious Photo, 2 Party Poppers.
Strategy: Earn Party Poppers in initial level-maxing. Submit the Precious Photo to initiate the beautiful final credits animation where Professor Tangrowth and Ditto wave goodbye.
steps.descZh:
物資需求：1 張珍愛照片、2 個派對拉炮。
獲取策略：派對拉炮能在荒原滿級任務中免費贈予；交回照片後，高塔將正式完成修復。你將迎來溫暖感人的結尾，巨蔓藤博士與百變怪燃放拉炮，並將照片送入深空，暗示人類探索太空船終尋得地球萌芽。

guides.titleZh: 專業圖鑑工具：網路五大權威資料庫與機制資料深度應用
guides.subtitleEn: Unlock hidden formulas, precise grid layouts, and milestone bonuses by utilizing the top databases tracked by the active community.
guides.subtitleZh: 為瞭解鎖隱藏神裝食譜、精確的網格佈建與圖鑑里程碑獎勵，本篇整合了網路上最熱門的《寶可夢 Pokopia》專業站點，並剖析各大工具的引路強項。

sections.titleZh: 各大站點實行指標與核心價值剖析
sections.contentEn: These five professional wikis handle specific sub-mechanics from precise decorations to statistical charts.
sections.contentZh: 這五個權威社群站點提供了不同維度的攻略，幫助你克服資訊不對稱，極速達成 300 隻全圖鑑收集與工業鏈極限稼動。

steps.nodeTitleZh: Nintendo Life：棲息地配置與具體傢俱數值
steps.descEn: Strength: Perfect integration of Pokedex and Habitat Dex requirements. Explains specific item ratios. For instance, 'Bench with Greenery' strictly requires 2 Hedges and 1 Chair.
steps.descZh: 強項功能：將「寶可夢圖鑑」與「棲息地圖鑑 (Habitat Dex)」完美結合，精確標明瞭每種環境所需的物件比例（例如要搭建「有綠意的長椅」，會明確指引需擺設 2 個樹籬與 1 張椅子），適閤家裝玩家。

steps.nodeTitleZh: Eurogamer：300 基礎圖鑑、愛好與活動專刊
steps.descEn: Strength: Hosts all 300 base entries plus Event Pokedex. Breaks details into traditional bio, habitat/weather, and specialties/likes. Understanding likes is key to high comfort.
steps.descZh: 強項功能：提供 300 隻基礎圖鑑與限時「活動圖鑑（Event Pokédex）」記錄。分為傳統生物、棲息天氣、以及最重要的「專長與喜好（Likes）」。掌控喜好是極速提升寶可夢家園舒適度的無上法門。

steps.nodeTitleZh: OP.GG Pokopia：極致篩選與環境偏好
steps.descEn: Strength: Outstanding UI for filtering by attribute, specialty, or environment preference (bright, humid, dark, dry, warm). Marks spawn rarity: C (Common), R (Rare), V (Very Rare).
steps.descZh: 強項功能：無與倫比的高速篩選。可根據寶可夢的屬性、專長、或環境偏好（明亮、潮濕、黑暗、乾燥、溫暖等五大指標）瞬時過濾。且印有極為精準的出沒稀有度指示標籤（Common C / Rare R / Very Rare V）。

steps.nodeTitleZh: Pokopia.center：招募五步迴圈與里程碑獎勵
steps.descEn: Strength: Detailed post-game regional statistics (Kanto ~50, Sinnoh ~14) and 5-step loop analysis. Formally records rewards like titles, garments, and Game Boy components upon reaching 200, 250, and 300 species milestones.
steps.descZh: 強項功能：最深度的宏觀資料分析。列出 1 到 9 世代在關都 (~50 隻) 與神奧 (~14 隻) 等地分佈；精析了招募 5 步迴圈；並精準記錄收集 200、250 與 300 隻時發放的「圖鑑滿載里程碑獎勵」（如專用稱號、高階服飾及 Game Boy 元件）。

steps.nodeTitleZh: Fandom Wiki：玩家社群百科與隱藏技巧
steps.descEn: Strength: Player-supported encyclopedia containing exhaustive items database, interactive grid coordinates, and secret structural blueprints discovered by active sandbox players.
steps.descZh: 強項功能：全集體智慧百科。由全球核心玩家聯動維護。收錄了最冷門的單件傢俱圖鑑、百變怪地形互動的隱藏格子坐標，以及論壇上玩家測試出的多套一鍵自動回收最佳管線配置。

guides.titleEn: Resource Refining: Core Material Production Chains
guides.titleZh: 資源精煉工業鏈：五大核心建材生產線全解析
guides.subtitleEn: Pokopia is built on a deep refining system. To clear badge quests and the giant end-game structures, you must integrate Pokémon of different specialties into proper production lines. Here is every core material chain, broken down node by node.
guides.subtitleZh: Pokopia 建立了一套極具深度的資源精煉系統。要應付徽章任務與終局大型工程，你必須把不同專長的寶可夢整合進生產線，形成工業鏈。以下逐節點拆解五大核心建材的生產流程。

sections.titleZh: 五大核心建材生產線
sections.contentEn: Each chain pairs a raw resource with a specialty Pokémon and a processing station. Set these up early and the mid-to-late game stops being a grind.
sections.contentZh: 每一條生產線都由「原料 ＋ 專長寶可夢 ＋ 加工裝置」三者組成。儘早把它們搭建起來，中後期就不再是無止盡的苦工。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 木材生產線（飛天螳螂・居合斬）
steps.descEn: Build a habitat with one large tree and four tall-grass plots to attract Scyther. Learn Cut to split logs into Small Wood Blocks, then commission Scyther to batch-process them into Lumber.
steps.descZh: 建造包含一棵大樹與四格高草叢的棲息地以吸引飛天螳螂。學會「居合斬」即可劈開圓木取得小木塊，再委託飛天螳螂批次切割成木材。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 磚塊生產線（火稚雞 / 小火龍・燃燒）
steps.descEn: Trigger rainfall in the wasteland to gather Soft Clay, then build a 啾啾餐 habitat to attract Torchic or Charmander. Commission these Burn-specialty partners to kiln-bake the clay into Bricks.
steps.descZh: 在荒野引發降雨以獲取「軟泥」，並建造「啾啾餐」棲息地吸引火稚雞或小火龍。委託這些具備「燃燒」專長的夥伴，將軟泥窯烤成磚塊。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 金屬錠生產線（破破袋・回收 ＋ 熔煉爐）
steps.descEn: Mine ore directly, or have Trubbish recycle non-combustible trash into Iron Ore. Build a Smelting Furnace and use a Fire-type's Burn ability to smelt the ore into Iron or Copper Ingots.
steps.descZh: 除了直接開採礦脈，也可邀請具備「回收」專長的破破袋將「不可燃垃圾」轉化為鐵礦。取得鐵礦或銅礦後，建造「熔煉爐」，再借助火系寶可夢的燃燒能力冶煉成鐵錠或銅錠。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 混凝土生產線（隆隆巖 ＋ 修建老匠）
steps.descEn: In the Sparkling Floating Island, build a Construction Generator habitat to attract Conkeldurr. Golem's Crush ability breaks rock into Limestone; place the Concrete Mixer in water and let Conkeldurr process the Limestone into Concrete.
steps.descZh: 在閃閃浮島建造「工地發電機」棲息地吸引修建老匠。隆隆巖的「粉碎」可將岩石破壞成石灰岩；把「混凝土攪拌機」置入水中，再交由修建老匠將石灰岩加工成混凝土。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 紙張生產線（廢紙・回收）
steps.descEn: Collect Waste Paper scattered across the Sparkling Floating Island and hand it to a Recycle-specialty Pokémon (such as Trubbish) to produce usable Paper for badges and 4F construction.
steps.descZh: 在閃閃浮島收集散落的「廢紙」，交由具「回收」專長的寶可夢（如破破袋）製作成可用的紙張，供徽章任務與摩天大樓 4F 建設使用。

guides.categoryZh: 終局自由建造區・空空鎮
guides.titleZh: 空空鎮終局自由建造區：伊布家族八型態復育全攻略
guides.subtitleEn: Clearing the main story unlocks the pure sandbox region of Empty Town, home to the toughest ecological challenge in the game—restoring Eevee and all eight of its evolutions. Every eeveelution habitat shares the same base recipe: 1 chair, 1 table, and 1 special food locked behind a specific milestone.
guides.subtitleZh: 完成主線後即解鎖純自由建造區域「空空鎮」，這裡藏著全作最嚴苛的生態挑戰——伊布及其八種進化型態的復育。所有伊布棲息地的基礎配方都相同：1 張椅子、1 張桌子，外加 1 種被鎖在特定里程碑之後的特殊食物。

sections.titleZh: 伊布與棲息地基礎配方
sections.contentEn: Eevee itself is encountered the moment you enter the Empty Town Pokémon Center—no special condition required—and carries the Trade specialty. Every evolution then needs the same base habitat (1 chair + 1 table) plus its own unique unlocked food.
sections.contentZh: 進入空空鎮寶可夢中心即可遭遇伊布本體，無任何特殊條件，且牠具備「交易」專長。之後每一種進化型態都需要相同的基礎棲息地（1 張椅子 ＋ 1 張桌子），再加上各自專屬、需解鎖的特殊食物。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 水伊布 — 冰淇淋汽水
steps.descEn: Unlock the Ice Cream Soda recipe by building 10 Water-type habitats throughout Empty Town.
steps.descZh: 在空空鎮建造 10 個水系棲息地，即可解鎖「冰淇淋汽水」食譜。

steps.descEn: Lay a total of 100 electrical facility blocks across the town to unlock the French Fries recipe.
steps.descZh: 在空空鎮鋪設合計 100 塊電力設施方塊，解鎖「炸薯條」食譜。

steps.descEn: Commission Pokémon to assist with construction tasks 15 times to unlock the Pizza recipe.
steps.descZh: 委託寶可夢協助建築施工合計 15 次，解鎖「披薩」食譜。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 太陽伊布 — 下午茶組（白天）
steps.descEn: Have a Pokémon roommate living in your residence. Espeon only spawns during daytime hours; the food unlocked is the Afternoon Tea Set.
steps.descZh: 需在居所中擁有一隻寶可夢室友同住。太陽伊布僅在白天時段生成；解鎖食物為「下午茶組」。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 月亮伊布 — 巧克力餅乾（夜間）
steps.descEn: The most demanding eeveelution: lay 300 physical road blocks to unlock the Chocolate Cookies recipe. Umbreon only spawns at night.
steps.descZh: 最硬核的型態：需鋪設高達 300 塊實體道路方塊，解鎖「巧克力餅乾」食譜。月亮伊布僅在夜間生成。

steps.descEn: Harvest 100 crops in total across Empty Town's farm plots to unlock the Sandwich recipe.
steps.descZh: 在空空鎮農田合計收成 100 株農作物，解鎖「三明治」食譜。

steps.descEn: Reach the highest elevation point of Empty Town's terrain (the summit of the tallest island peak) to unlock the Shaved Ice recipe.
steps.descZh: 抵達空空鎮地形的最高海拔點（最高島嶼山頂），解鎖「刨冰」食譜。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 仙子伊布 — 緞帶蛋糕
steps.descEn: Encounter 10 different Pokémon species within Empty Town to unlock the Ribbon Cake recipe.
steps.descZh: 在空空鎮範圍內遭遇合計 10 種不同的寶可夢，解鎖「緞帶蛋糕」食譜。

sections.titleZh: VGC / Pokopia.center 底層「反進化」生態學
sections.contentEn: Pokopia completely removes traditional EXP and battle-based evolution. Pokémon form transformations are driven by the Habitat Drive Model, requiring specific friendship thresholds, precise furniture layouts, and seasonal event triggers.
sections.contentZh: 本作徹底取消了傳統經驗值與戰鬥升等。寶可夢型態轉換改由「棲息地驅動模型 (Habitat Drive Model)」與高階指標觸發，這需要特定的友情等級、精確的家具配置以及季節性活動解鎖。

steps.descEn: Friendship level acts as the gateway: Level 5 unlocks Stage 1 evolution habitat designs, while Level 10 unlocks Stage 2 (final form) habitat requirements.
steps.descZh: 友情等級是進化的敲門磚：幼體友情等級達到 5 級能解鎖一階進化型態的棲息地配置條件，達到 10 級則解鎖最終型態的棲息地配置條件。

steps.descEn: Attracting advanced forms requires placing specific furniture types (over 200+ unique furniture pieces available) paired with precise environment attributes.
steps.descZh: 吸引高階進化型態對裝潢極其挑剔。玩家需配合地區環境，在棲地附近精確擺放複數的特定家具（遊戲中包含 200 種以上的精確家具配置）。

steps.descEn: Certain Pokémon form shifts are unlocked strictly via real-world or seasonal in-game events, such as the March 'Hoppip's More Spores' event.
steps.descZh: 某些特定寶可夢的型態變化與特殊的季節活動繫結。例如 3 月份舉辦的「毽子草的更多孢子（Hoppip's More Spores）」特別活動。

guides.titleZh: Pokopia 全球前線攻略指南與資料庫總匯
guides.subtitleEn: A curated collection of essential external resources, including beginner walkthroughs, hidden mechanics, and comprehensive database tools.
guides.subtitleZh: 本篇彙整了全球社群、論壇與專業圖鑑網站的最佳攻略連結，涵蓋開荒流程、隱藏機制到圖鑑解鎖極限條件。

sections.titleZh: 新手開荒與前線社群
sections.contentEn: Essential walkthroughs and tips for accelerating your early-game progression and staying updated with events.
sections.contentZh: 精選新手村實用訣竅、主線通關路線，以及最前線的日文情報站。

steps.descEn: 15 crucial long-term tips I wish I knew earlier.
steps.descZh: 長線規劃必讀的 15 個開局訣竅（包含自動化生產三人組與環境評分解說）。

steps.descEn: Detailed regional walkthroughs and progression systems.
steps.descZh: 涵蓋各區域主線流程解說與過關推薦策略。

steps.descEn: Taiwanese community thread sharing essential QoL and hidden tricks.
steps.descZh: 「一人一個小知識！」玩家社群驗證的實用 QoL 密技（如工作臺與收納箱連動）。

steps.descEn: The fastest updating Japanese database for events and recipes.
steps.descZh: 日文最速前線資訊，提供最完整的傢俱製作食譜與限時活動即時更新。

sections.titleZh: 機制與圖鑑權威
sections.contentEn: Advanced breakdowns for milestone challenges, legendary coordinates, and extreme Eeveelution conditions.
sections.contentZh: 深度解謎機制的權威資料庫，破解伊布極限條件、傳奇工程數據與物資神技指引。

steps.descEn: Detailed report on the underlying mechanics of 'canceling traditional battle level-up evolution'.
steps.descZh: 完整報導本作「取消傳統戰鬥升級進化」的底層機制，解析將型態變化與棲息地傢俱、食物配方綁定的革命性設計。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 伊布家族解鎖極限條件 (Games.gg / Pokopia.center)
steps.descEn: The definitive guide for unlocking all 8 Eeveelutions in Empty Town.
steps.descZh: 統整空空鎮純自由建造區域中，伊布全 8 種型態的嚴苛解鎖條件配置。

steps.nodeTitleZh: Eurogamer 區域圖文通關指南
steps.descEn: Comprehensive western guides covering Gloomy Seaside and Sparkling Floating Island puzzles.
steps.descZh: 詳盡的圖文區域解析，深入暗沉沉海邊與閃閃浮島的地景謎題。

steps.nodeTitleZh: GameTyrant 物資提煉與電磁飄浮神技指南
steps.descEn: Masterclass on industrial mass production and Magnet Rise logistics.
steps.descZh: 精煉核心物資的最佳產線搭配，以及電磁飄浮能力的應用神技。

steps.descEn: Community calculations for extreme legendary structures like Kanto Birds Altars.
steps.descZh: 匯集社群硬核玩家測試出的終局建築佔地網格（如 33x35 火焰鳥祭壇等）。

guides.titleZh: 日文前線情報：季節交替與限時活動總整理
guides.subtitleEn: Based on GameWith's frontline database, here are the major limited-time events, pop-up challenges, and seasonal furniture drops you can expect as in-game time progresses.
guides.subtitleZh: 根據日本最大前線攻略網站 GameWith 的即時情報追蹤，本作在遊戲內時間推移下，會發生多種短期活動與特殊 NPC 挑戰。及早準備才能順利收集限定傢俱。

sections.titleZh: 春季重點時程：集棉、跳繩與寶石追尋
sections.contentEn: Early spring in Pokopia is packed with collection events requiring you to have at least one reconstructed Pokémon Center to trigger them.
sections.contentZh: 遊戲內的春季充滿了收集類型的限時活動，請務必確認你已經修好各地區的「寶可夢中心」，這通常是觸發事件的必備前置條件。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 毽子草的綿毛收集（遊戲內 3/10 ~ 3/25）
steps.descEn: Hoppip, Skiploom, and Jumpluff make special appearances. Gather their stray fluff to craft exclusive "Picnic-themed" decorations. Occurs only in areas with a repaired Poké Center.
steps.descZh: 活動期間毽子草、毽子花與毽子棉會大量出現在野外。收集牠們隨風飄散的棉毛，可兌換專屬的「野餐主題」傢俱。限於已修復寶可夢中心的城鎮發生。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 愚人節：大模仿家問答大會（遊戲內 4/1 ~ 4/2）
steps.descEn: A 24-hour special Mimic Challenge. Answer rapid-fire silhouette and impersonation quizzes to unlock prankster furniture.
steps.descZh: 僅限 24 小時的特殊挑戰！你要面對百變怪的「模仿猜謎」連發，連續答對即可獲得充滿惡作劇風格的稀有傢俱。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 全員大跳繩挑戰（遊戲內 4/19 ~ 4/27）
steps.descEn: A rhythm mini-game where your town's Pokémon jump together. Higher consecutive jumps yield better supply rewards.
steps.descZh: 節奏類迷你遊戲。將城鎮裡的寶可夢召集起來一起跳大繩，連續跳躍次數越高、獲得的重工業物資與特殊獎勵越豐厚。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 勾魂眼的寶石獵人（遊戲內 4/29 ~ 5/14）
steps.descEn: Sableye will appear asking for specific excavated gems. Rewards include dark, gem-studded luxury furniture.
steps.descZh: 神出鬼沒的勾魂眼會發布寶石懸賞。進入礦區挖出牠指定的寶石類型交貨，就能入手鑲滿閃耀原石的暗黑奢華風裝飾。

sections.titleEn: Dream Islands Expeditions (ゆめしま) & Beast Trials
sections.titleZh: 進階探索：夢境群島 (ゆめしま) 運作與聖獸試煉全解析
sections.contentEn: GameWith outlines the absolute mechanics of the Yumeshima system. By feeding specific dolls to Drifloon, players traverse to high-tier biomes containing Legendary beasts and rare resource nodes.
sections.contentZh: 根據 GameWith 的核心資料庫整理：「夢境群島」不僅是取得稀有自然物資的隨機浮動島嶼，更是遭遇與招募城都地區「傳說三聖獸」的唯一通道。理解其觸發機制是後期發展的絕對關鍵。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 娃娃獻祭與夢境傳送法則
steps.descEn: Interact with Drifloon (飄飄球) and hand over specific stuffed Pokémon dolls to be carried away. The type of doll given serves as an environmental anchor, dictating which randomized dream island biome you will arrive on.
steps.descZh: 在修復後的城鎮中尋找神出鬼沒的「飄飄球（Drifloon）」。將特定種類的「寶可夢娃娃」贈送予牠，即可讓牠抓著你飛越時空降落隨機夢境島。不同的娃娃種類將作為地貌媒介，嚴格決定島嶼的生態系（例如：皮卡丘娃娃對應海洋型地景）。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 四大上位夢之島生態系
steps.descEn: Explorations lead to Wasteland Dream Island (荒野), Ocean Dream Island (汪洋), Crag Dream Island (岩山), and Sky Dream Island (天空). Each operates as a high-yield version of Kanto biomes, boasting extremely rare gathering nodes and rare spawn pools.
steps.descZh: 群島共有四種型態：「荒野夢境島」、「汪洋夢境島」、「岩山夢境島」與「天空夢境島」。島嶼內富含一般地圖不可見的極度罕見礦脈與草木採集點，更是高階材料大量爆發的風水寶地。

steps.nodeTitleEn: Beast Trial Example: Raikou’s Cavern Obstacle
steps.nodeTitleZh: 三聖獸試煉實務：雷公與金屬方塊
steps.descEn: To recruit Raikou, transfer to the 'Pikachu Doll Dream Island (Ocean)'. Progress to the deepest cavern where Heavy Metal Blocks seal Raikou's sanctuary. You must eat a 'Hamburger Steak' cooked on Bulging Highlands' furnaces to gain extreme strength, then smash the blocks to initiate enrollment.
steps.descZh: 以招募雷公為例：將「皮卡丘娃娃」交給飄飄球傳送至「海洋型夢境島」，一路深入島嶼最底部的「深處洞穴（Deep Cavern）」。雷公被極為沉重的「特殊金屬方塊」困在祭壇中，玩家必須於背包食入加成道具──「漢堡排」（由凸隆隆山地熔爐烤製），獲得破格碎岩力，擊碎巨石障礙後方可招募雷公同行。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 聖獸定居與環境等級大幅飛躍
steps.descEn: Recruiting a legendary beast allows you to construct its high-end habitat back in your main town, instantly boosting the regional environment rating and comfort. This in turn triggers a flood of rare regular Pokémon migrations into your settlement.
steps.descZh: 完成聖獸招募後，便能在你的常規城鎮中為其興建專屬棲息地。安置傳說寶可夢會使整個區域的「環境等級」與「舒適度評分」獲得突飛猛進的爆發性增長，從而使前所未見的稀有普通寶可夢大量向你的營地靠攏移民。

sections.titleZh: 限時活動行事曆（2026 春季）
sections.contentEn: Concrete, time-boxed events with their exact windows and rewards, compiled from frontline community coverage. All times sync daily at 05:00 local.
sections.contentZh: 整理自前線社群的具體限時活動，附上精確時段與獎勵。所有活動每日於當地時間 05:00 同步刷新。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 勾魂眼收集寶石（第二彈）
steps.descEn: Apr 29 – May 14, 2026. Encounter Sableye at any rebuilt Pokémon Center; farm red crystal shards in fire-themed Dream-Island caves and trade for 10 camping-themed furniture items (Adventure Set 10, Tent 10, etc.).
steps.descZh: 2026/4/29–5/14。在任一重建的寶可夢中心遇見勾魂眼；於火屬性夢境島洞穴採集紅色水晶碎片，兌換 10 種露營主題家具（探險組 10、帳篷 10 等）。

steps.descEn: Apr 19 – 26, 2026. Unlock via the 'yawn up rain' quest, then play solo at any Pokémon Center or multiplayer in towns / Cloud Islands; highest jump count earns trophy-tier commemorative rewards.
steps.descZh: 2026/4/19–26。完成「打哈欠降雨」任務後解鎖，可於任一寶可夢中心單人遊玩，或在城鎮／雲島多人連線；成功跳繩次數越高，獎盃級紀念獎勵越豐厚。

steps.descEn: Apr 1, 2026 only (24h). Find Pokémon mimicking others' speech, answer 3 riddles correctly, then report at a Pokémon Center PC to claim the limited 'Sudowoodo Balloon' collectible.
steps.descZh: 僅 2026/4/1（24 小時）。找出偷偷模仿其他寶可夢說話的個體，累計答對 3 題，再到寶可夢中心電腦回報，領取限定「樹才怪氣球」收藏品。

guides.titleZh: 廚藝大全：24 道料理與技能強化食譜
guides.subtitleEn: Pokopia's 24 dishes are not flavor text — each cooking station maps to one of Ditto's core skills, and every dish layers a secondary buff for encounters, rare-item finds, shop quality, or friendship.
guides.subtitleZh: 《Pokopia》的 24 道料理並非裝飾——每種烹飪器具對應百變怪的一項核心技能，而每道菜還會附帶遭遇率、稀有道具、商店品質或友好度等次要增益。

sections.titleZh: 四種器具・四種技能
sections.contentEn: Each cooking station strengthens exactly one Ditto skill. Match the station to the skill you want to upgrade before chasing specific ingredients.
sections.contentZh: 每種烹飪器具只會強化百變怪的一項技能。先依想強化的技能選對器具，再去湊特定食材。

steps.descEn: Breads boost Cut power — the upgraded Slash widens its range and breaks metal nets. Base recipe: Wheat + filler.
steps.descZh: 麵包類強化居合斬——強化後可加大斬擊範圍並切斷金屬網。基礎配方：小麥＋填充食材。

steps.descEn: Burgers boost Rock Smash — the Burger Patty famously lets Ditto shatter hard ore/metal with fewer hits. Base recipe: Beans + filler ×2.
steps.descZh: 漢堡排類強化碎岩——招牌的漢堡排能讓百變怪以更少次數擊碎硬礦／金屬。基礎配方：豆子＋填充 ×2。

steps.descEn: Salads boost Leaf — improves planting/growth coverage. Base recipe: Leaf + a second leaf-type ingredient.
steps.descZh: 沙拉類強化樹葉——提升種植與生長覆蓋。基礎配方：樹葉＋第二種葉系食材。

steps.descEn: Soups boost Water Gun — widens the spray for irrigation. Base recipe: Fresh Water + filler.
steps.descZh: 湯品類強化水槍——加大澆灌噴射範圍。基礎配方：清水＋填充食材。

sections.titleZh: 招牌與遭遇率料理
sections.contentEn: Beyond the skill boost, the second effect is what makes a recipe worth cooking. These are the high-value dishes worth memorizing.
sections.contentZh: 技能強化之外，第二效果才是值得開伙的關鍵。以下是最值得記住的高價值料理。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 蘑菇漢堡排／蘑菇湯 → 鳳王與洛奇亞
steps.descEn: Mushroom dishes (and Mashed Salad) add 'slightly easier to encounter Ho-Oh/Lugia' — pair with the bell routes for the two tower legendaries.
steps.descZh: 蘑菇料理（與搗碎沙拉）附帶「較易遭遇鳳王／洛奇亞」效果——搭配鈴鐺路線專攻雙塔傳說。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 馬鈴薯漢堡排／鬆軟麵包 → 古代道具
steps.descEn: These add 'very easy to find ancient items' — ideal before fossil-dig and Mysterious-Slate runs.
steps.descZh: 這些附帶「非常容易發現古代道具」——挖化石與蒐集神秘石板前的首選。

steps.nodeTitleZh: 帶遭遇增益的湯／沙拉 → 棲地補員
steps.descEn: Hot Soup Bread Bowl, Crouton Salad and Herbal Soup make a habitat 'very easy to encounter Pokémon' — cook before staffing a new habitat.
steps.descZh: 熱騰騰湯麵包、麵包丁沙拉與藥膳湯使棲地「非常容易遭遇寶可夢」——佈置新棲地前先煮一份。

guides.titleEn: 31 Specialties & 14 Unique Traits: The Automation Atlas
guides.titleZh: 31 種專長與 14 種特殊特性：自動化全解析
guides.subtitleEn: Pokopia treats Pokémon as labor roles. Knowing which specialty does what — and which three combine into a self-running factory — is the difference between grinding and idling.
guides.subtitleZh: 《Pokopia》把寶可夢視為職能。搞懂每種專長的作用，以及哪三種能組成自動工廠，正是「苦工」與「掛機」之間的分水嶺。

sections.titleZh: 全自動熔煉產線
sections.contentEn: The single most important combo in the game: pair these three specialties and iron ingots and bricks produce themselves, even while you are offline.
sections.contentZh: 全作最重要的組合：把這三種專長湊在一起，鐵塊與磚塊就會自動產出，連你離線時也持續運轉。

steps.descEn: Randomly drops 1–4 basic materials near the habitat, even offline. Use Scatter (iron) and Scatter (clay) Pokémon to seed the line.
steps.descZh: 即使離線也會在棲地附近隨機掉落 1–4 個基礎素材。用「亂灑（鐵）」與「亂灑（黏土）」的寶可夢供料。

steps.descEn: Automatically carries dropped materials into the Community Box so the next station can pull from it.
steps.descZh: 自動把掉落素材搬進「共享箱」，供下一站取用。

steps.descEn: Lights and operates furnaces, smelting the gathered ore/clay into ingots and bricks. Scatter + Sorting + Ignition = fully automated metal/brick production.
steps.descZh: 點燃並操作熔爐，把收集的礦／黏土煉成錠與磚。亂灑＋分類＋點火＝鐵塊與磚塊全自動產線。

sections.titleZh: 專長型錄（重點）
sections.contentEn: The remaining specialties cover growth, power, logistics and services. Key constraints: Construction is Fighting-types only; Trample (demolish/rebuild) is Rock/Ground-types.
sections.contentZh: 其餘專長涵蓋生長、供電、物流與服務。關鍵限制：建造僅限格鬥系；重踏（拆除／重建）僅限岩石／地面系。

steps.descEn: Cultivation speeds crops/trees; Moisture waters crops and cleans ground oil; Power Generation supplies one full day of electricity.
steps.descZh: 栽培加速作物／樹木；滋潤澆灌作物並清除地面油污；發電供應整整一天的電力。

steps.descEn: Logging → wood; Recycling → waste paper into paper; Grinding → berries into colored dye; Item Search → locate buried treasure spots.
steps.descZh: 伐木→木材；回收利用→廢紙轉紙張；碾壓→果實磨成染料；找東西→定位地下寶藏點。

steps.descEn: Flight / Teleportation fetch lost Pokémon from other habitats; Trading runs a shop stage for exchanges.
steps.descZh: 飛翔／瞬間移動可從其他棲地帶回走失的寶可夢；交易則開設商店進行物資兌換。

sections.titleZh: 值得專程蒐集的 14 種特殊特性
sections.contentEn: Beyond specialties, 14 individual Pokémon carry one-of-a-kind traits. Two are effectively mandatory.
sections.contentZh: 專長之外，有 14 隻寶可夢各自擁有獨一無二的特性，其中兩種幾乎是必備。

steps.descEn: Converts metal into Special Gears and substitutes for Construction — essential for lifts and the Huge Building. Effectively mandatory late-game.
steps.descZh: 把金屬轉成特殊齒輪並可替代建造——升降梯與巨大建築不可或缺。後期幾乎必備。

steps.descEn: Your own avatar: copies skills from other Pokémon. The backbone of the entire progression.
steps.descZh: 玩家本體：複製其他寶可夢的技能，是整套進度的核心。

steps.descEn: Drifloon → Dream Island ferry; Slowpoke → Yawn rain (story); Hill-Pokémon → Glow city lighting; Voltorb line → Explosion terrain blasting; Smeargle → furniture painting; Rotom → DJ music CDs.
steps.descZh: 飄飄球→夢境島渡送；呆呆獸→呵欠降雨（劇情）；淺淺丘→發光照明城鎮；雷電球系→爆炸炸地形；圖圖犬→家具彩繪；洛托姆→DJ 播放音樂 CD。

guides.titleZh: 百變怪 14 招式一覽與料理強化
guides.subtitleEn: Every Ditto skill is copied by completing a specific Pokémon's request. Four of them also accept a cooked-dish upgrade that widens their range or power.
guides.subtitleZh: 百變怪的每項技能都來自完成特定寶可夢的請求；其中四項還能透過料理升級，加大範圍或威力。

sections.titleZh: 可料理強化的四大核心招式
sections.contentEn: These four are the spine of progression and each has a matching cooking upgrade.
sections.contentZh: 這四招是進度主幹，且各自對應一種料理強化。

steps.descEn: Copied by talking to Squirtle at the start. Soup dishes expand the spray range for irrigation.
steps.descZh: 開場與傑尼龜對話即可複製。湯品料理可加大澆灌噴射範圍。

steps.descEn: Copied via Bulbasaur's request. Salad dishes grant a cross-shaped planting area.
steps.descZh: 完成妙蛙種子的請求複製。沙拉料理可解鎖十字形種植範圍。

steps.descEn: Copied via Scyther's request. Bread dishes increase Slash range and let it break metal nets.
steps.descZh: 完成飛天螳螂的請求複製。麵包料理增加斬擊範圍並可切斷金屬網。

steps.descEn: Copied via Primeape's request. The Burger Patty upgrades it to break hard rock with fewer hits.
steps.descZh: 完成火爆猴的請求複製。漢堡排可將其強化為更少次數擊碎硬岩。

sections.titleZh: 移動與功能招式
sections.contentEn: The remaining ten unlock movement and special interactions as you progress regions.
sections.contentZh: 其餘十招隨區域推進解鎖移動與特殊互動。

steps.descEn: Till (Diglett), Strength (Machamp), Roll (meet Graveler via the Machamp task), Jump (Magikarp).
steps.descZh: 耕地（地鼠）、怪力（怪力）、滾動（藉怪力任務遇見隆隆石）、躍起（鯉魚王）。

steps.descEn: Surf (Lapras), Water Absorb (meet Palossand via the Piplup task), Waterfall (Gyarados).
steps.descZh: 衝浪（拉普拉斯）、蓄水（藉波加曼任務遇見沙螺蟒）、攀瀑（暴鯉龍）。

steps.descEn: Glide (Dragonite), Magnet Rise (Magnemite — pick up & reposition blocks/trees), Mimic (Zoroark).
steps.descZh: 滑翔（快龍）、電磁飄浮（小磁怪——隔空抓取並重擺方塊／樹木）、模仿（索羅亞克）。

guides.titleEn: Habitat Engineering: Attract Any Pokémon by Design
guides.titleZh: 棲息地製作圖鑑：用佈置吸引指定寶可夢
guides.subtitleEn: Habitats are recipes too. The right combination of furniture, plants and substrate spawns specific species — focus resources on one or two targets at a time.
guides.subtitleZh: 棲息地本身也是配方。家具、植物與地面材質的正確組合會吸引特定物種——一次集中資源主攻一到兩隻即可。

sections.titleZh: 棲息地運作原理
sections.contentEn: Each habitat number is a fixed material recipe that attracts a defined species pool. New players should pick 1–2 desired Pokémon and gather only their materials rather than spreading thin.
sections.contentZh: 每個棲地編號都是固定的材料配方，對應一組可吸引的物種。新手應先鎖定 1–2 隻目標，只蒐集其所需材料，別分散資源。

sections.titleZh: 高 CP 值入門棲地
sections.contentEn: A few cheap, broad-coverage habitats to build first.
sections.contentZh: 幾個便宜又涵蓋廣的優先棲地。

steps.descEn: Cheapest broad starter: attracts Bulbasaur, Charmander, Charizard, Squirtle, Bellsprout and Geodude.
steps.descZh: 最便宜的廣域入門：吸引妙蛙種子、小火龍、噴火龍、傑尼龜、喇叭芽與小拳石。

steps.descEn: Attracts Pidgeot, Beedrill, Eevee, Pidgeotto and Psyduck — an early Eevee source.
steps.descZh: 吸引大比鳥、大針蜂、伊布、比比鳥與可達鴨——早期伊布來源。

steps.descEn: Fruit Camping Feast (weather balloon ×2, campfire, fruit basket, high ground) → Charizard; Pikachu Space (Pikachu sofa + plush) → Mimikyu.
steps.descZh: 水果露營盛宴（氣象氣球 ×2、營火、水果籃、高地）→ 噴火龍；皮卡丘空間（皮卡丘沙發＋玩偶）→ 謎擬Q。

guides.titleEn: Cloud Island Codes: Official, Celebrity & CoroCoro
guides.titleZh: 雲島地址碼大全：官方島、名人島與 CoroCoro
guides.subtitleEn: Virtual-mode islands let you photograph rare items and 3D-print copies back home. You need the Mystery Goggles and Nintendo Switch Online.
guides.subtitleZh: 虛擬模式島嶼可拍攝稀有道具，回到自家島用 3D 印表機複製。需要「神秘護目鏡」與 Nintendo Switch Online。

sections.titleZh: 進入條件
sections.contentEn: Buy the Mystery Goggles at the Withered Wasteland Pokémon Center PC shop once environment level reaches 3, and maintain a Switch Online membership. Photograph an item with Y, then duplicate it on your home island via the 3D Printer.
sections.contentZh: 環境等級達 3 後，於乾巴巴荒野寶可夢中心的電腦商店購買「神秘護目鏡」，並需 Switch Online 會員。用 Y 鍵拍攝道具，回自家島用 3D 印表機複製。

sections.titleZh: 官方與名人島代碼
sections.contentEn: Codes as of early May 2026. EIKO City and Sashihara Island are confirmed to expire Aug 12, 2026.
sections.contentZh: 代碼更新至 2026 年 5 月初。EIKO 城與指原島已確認於 2026/8/12 到期。

steps.descEn: Code PXQC G03S — features a Gengar habitat.
steps.descZh: 代碼 PXQC G03S——設有耿鬼棲息地。

steps.descEn: EIKO City QBRK 7FVM (Metagross habitat); Sashihara Island MGL4 83P4 (floating beds). Both expire Aug 12, 2026.
steps.descZh: EIKO 城 QBRK 7FVM（巨金怪棲息地）；指原島 MGL4 83P4（漂浮床）。皆於 2026/8/12 到期。

steps.descEn: Color Peach 0XGP 4N31; IKEA Island 0SJ8 5TRX (IKEA furniture); Dozuru Island BVLC 8WX6; Hana-chan MYRS 615H; YUMMYYUMMY 03X3 H83D.
steps.descZh: 彩色桃子島 0XGP 4N31；IKEA 島 0SJ8 5TRX（IKEA 家具）；ドズル島 BVLC 8WX6；花花島 MYRS 615H；YUMMYYUMMY 島 03X3 H83D。

sections.titleZh: CoroCoro 島・23 件道具寶庫
sections.contentEn: Address MJ6X PRMQ. The richest single island: 23 obtainable items.
sections.contentZh: 地址 MJ6X PRMQ。單島最豐富：共 23 件可取得道具。

steps.descEn: 8 fossils (Wing, Headbutt, Skull, Shield, Lid, Feather, Tundra, Fin) plus 2 special armors (Celebration, Curse).
steps.descZh: 8 種化石（翅膀、頭錘、頭蓋、盾、蓋、羽毛、凍土、鰭）外加 2 種特殊盔甲（慶典、詛咒）。

steps.descEn: 2 foods (Fried Potatoes, Pizza), 6 furniture (Arcade Machine, Punching Machine, Sleepy Bed, Mini Generator, Bicycle, e-sports set) and every fruit-tree variety — including ones that don't grow elsewhere.
steps.descZh: 2 種食物（炸薯條、披薩）、6 種家具（街機、拳擊機、好眠床、迷你發電機、腳踏車、電競家具組）以及所有果樹品種——含他處不生長的品種。

guides.subtitleZh: 所有營運相關：可用兌換序號、免序號禮物、官方對 DLC 的立場，以及更新至 v1.0.4 的修補紀錄。

sections.titleZh: 序號與神秘禮物
sections.contentEn: Redeem via Pokémon Center PC → Receive Items → Mystery Gift → Internet or Code. Dates below are claim deadlines.
sections.contentZh: 於寶可夢中心電腦 → 收取道具 → 神秘禮物 → 透過網路或序號領取。下列日期為領取期限。

steps.descEn: P0K0P1AGARDENS — enter via the Mystery Gift code option.
steps.descZh: P0K0P1AGARDENS——由神秘禮物的序號選項輸入。

steps.descEn: Ditto Rug (early-purchase, claim until Jan 31 2027); Munchlax Meal Set (like the News Bureau X post; valid to Feb 28 2027); Flat Planter (Amazon bonus, redeem by Jan 31 2027).
steps.descZh: 百變怪地毯（早期購買，領取至 2027/1/31）；卡比寶餐組（按讚情報局 X 貼文；有效至 2027/2/28）；平面花盆（Amazon 特典，2027/1/31 前兌換）。

sections.titleZh: DLC 常見問題
sections.contentEn: As of May 3, 2026 there is no paid DLC, expansion pass, or season pass announced. Support is delivered through free bug-fix patches and free seasonal events; any future DLC is speculative until officially announced.
sections.contentZh: 截至 2026/5/3，官方尚未公布任何付費 DLC、擴充票或季票。後續支援以免費修補與免費限時活動為主；在官方正式公布前，任何 DLC 傳聞皆屬猜測。

sections.titleZh: 版本更新紀錄
sections.contentEn: Latest patches and their headline changes.
sections.contentZh: 近期版本與其重點變更。

steps.descEn: Adds moving the Pokémon Center during special events; fixes 13+ bugs (Gloomy Seaside quest progression, NPC encounters, PC crash, event decoration floating).
steps.descZh: 新增可在特殊活動期間移動寶可夢中心；修復 13+ 項錯誤（暗沉沉海邊任務進度、NPC 遭遇、電腦當機、活動裝飾浮空）。

steps.descEn: 1.0.3 fixed Dream-Island teleport dumping players in Empty Town, habitat-less Pokémon search, and Cloud-Island despawns; 1.0.2 clarified rock-breaking / Snorlax quests and Pokédex attributes.
steps.descZh: 1.0.3 修復前往夢境島被傳送到空空鎮、無棲地寶可夢搜尋、雲島寶可夢消失等問題；1.0.2 釐清碎岩／卡比獸任務與圖鑑屬性。

steps.descEn: Enabled online functionality; online features require the latest version.
steps.descZh: 啟用線上功能；連線功能需更新至最新版本。

guides.titleEn: Key Material & Item Acquisition: Ice, Red Crystals & Game Boy
guides.titleZh: 關鍵素材與道具取得：冰塊、紅水晶與 Game Boy
guides.subtitleEn: Three high-demand acquisitions that gate late-game projects: ice blocks for Articuno, red crystal shards for the Sableye event, and the Game Boy reward item.
guides.subtitleZh: 三項卡關後期工程的高需求取得：急凍鳥所需的冰塊、勾魂眼活動的紅水晶碎片，以及 Game Boy 獎勵道具。

sections.titleZh: 冰塊 → 冰結之室 → 急凍鳥
sections.contentEn: Primary farm: the Empty Town secret cave — east-side waterfall, walk to its right, enter the passage by the glowing mushroom; ice blocks and crystal shards respawn there. Secondary: the Pippi-doll Dream Island center rocks.
sections.contentZh: 主要採集：空空鎮的祕密洞穴——東側瀑布右方、發光蘑菇旁的暗道進入，冰塊與水晶碎片會重生。次要：皮皮娃娃夢境島中央岩塊。

steps.descEn: Needs 50 ice blocks, 50 stone, 10 crystal shards, 10 Pokémetal, plus a 15-Pokémon crew (Build / Water / Search). Completes in ~1 in-game day and spawns Articuno.
steps.descZh: 需 50 冰塊、50 石頭、10 水晶碎片、10 寶可金屬，外加 15 隻施工隊（建造／水／找東西）。約 1 遊戲日完工並召喚急凍鳥。

sections.titleZh: 紅水晶碎片（勾魂眼活動貨幣）
sections.contentEn: Break red crystal clusters in Dream-Island caves with Rock Smash (~4 shards each; a smooth run yields 60–70). Best caves are reached via the Clefairy or Growlithe dolls.
sections.contentZh: 用碎岩擊破夢境島洞穴中的紅水晶簇（每簇約 4 片，順利一趟可得 60–70 片）。最佳洞穴經由皮皮或卡蒂狗娃娃進入。

steps.descEn: 20 shards buys the basic treasure-set habitat (Adventure Set 10 + Map & Compass 5 + Treasure 5); 64 shards clears the entire Sableye event shop in one run.
steps.descZh: 20 片可購入基礎寶藏組棲地（探險組 10＋地圖羅盤 5＋寶藏 5）；64 片可一趟買光整個勾魂眼活動商店。

sections.titleZh: Game Boy（獎勵道具）
sections.contentEn: Reach environment level 5 in Sparkling Floating Island, then either accept it free from Professor Tangrowth, or craft it for 1 Pokémetal + 1,000 coins.
sections.contentZh: 在閃閃浮島達到環境等級 5 後，可向巨蔓藤博士免費領取，或以 1 寶可金屬＋1,000 金幣製作。

steps.descEn: Required (with a Washing Machine and Refrigerator) for Team Initiation Challenge Part 7 → Crimson Badge. Also a toy-type decoration that boosts comfort for toy-loving Pokémon (e.g. Growlithe, Wigglytuff) and plays the Game Boy startup sound.
steps.descZh: 與洗衣機、冰箱一同為入團挑戰第 7 彈所需 → 緋紅徽章。也是玩具類裝飾，提升喜歡玩具的寶可夢（如卡蒂狗、胖可丁）舒適度，並會播放 Game Boy 開機音效。
